rfq.benchmark_how_body: Built only from jobs that were paid for on AMClub in the last 180 days — never from quotes. Figures are rounded, and no individual price is ever shown. It is information, not a recommendation.

munshi.title: Munshi — your sales clerk
munshi.subtitle: Every 15 minutes Munshi reads your new requests, checks your own price history and drafts a quote, one question, or a skip. You approve on WhatsApp, here, or in the app; nothing is sent without your tap.
munshi.enable_what: What it does: reads your matched requests and clarifications, checks your price book and confirmed capabilities, drafts a quote with its price basis, one clarifying question, or a skip with a reason; warns you before a request lapses; drafts replies when a buyer messages on a quote.
munshi.enable_never: What it never does: it never invents a price (no price history, no quote), never sends anything without your approval, never changes your profile, and never talks to buyers on its own.
munshi.consent_text: By enabling Munshi you allow AMClub to read your requests, quotes and price history on your behalf and to send you drafts on WhatsApp when you have opted in. You can pause or disable it any time; drafts already sent stay in your history.
munshi.whatsapp_off: Send START to our WhatsApp number to also get drafts there.
